prompt: Painterly cinematic realism with Old-Master light, one warm grade, fine film grain. Wide shot. A brilliant rainbow glowing against the dark retreating storm clouds, a family in silhouette, in ankle-length rough undyed wool robes and head-cloths, barefoot, standing below it on wet grass with their backs to the camera. Late afternoon, sun behind them. Awe. The ancient Near East in the days of the flood: the open water, the mountains of Ararat and the empty new earth. No stone buildings, towers, churches, glass lanterns, modern clothing or roads. No text, no logos.
